title: Just remembered some locations I’ve seen
content: Last night: I was at what seemed like a college for a sporting event - maybe swim competition. I was scrambling to find where I was supposed to be but kept going from hallway to a large classroom full of people sitting in folding chairs, over and over. I’ve had dreams of stadium-sized swimming pools/water parks before but it wasn’t the same as those. Another thing I’ve seen multiple times in the past: freeways that don’t make sense. Picture 2 or 3 parallel sets of road at different elevations. I’m never sure which one will take me where I need to go as they will end abruptly at random places.
